column4: cleat#4079: forEachBackend loops this test over postgres/mysql/mssql via t.Run(<dialect>), and test-go/engine sets only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES, so the mysql/mssql arm(s) skip as 'backend not enabled'. A skip for an environmental precondition (a DSN that is not set); measured by name with only the Postgres DSN set: 1 skip event per other-dialect arm, none at the top level.
